short_description:
GTA 6's giant crab easter egg: an abandoned crab research outpost in the Gullet Marsh channels of Pelican Valley, reached by boat. Restore power at the breaker box outside, then use the password CLEAVES to see what's inside. Guides disagree on whether you can fight the crab off. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: Dexerto, TheGamer, The Click, Red Bull.
